items.headline: NFL Week 4 uniforms: Browns wearing 'Alpha Dawg' look; Giants go 'Legacy'
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 4, led by an alternate look from the Cleveland Browns.

items.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels says he's taking injury day by day
items.description: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels said Thursday he has no concerns about reinjuring his left elbow and is "taking it day by day" on the possibility of starting against the Colts on Sunday in London.

items.headline: Austin Ekeler set to return after near career-ending injury
items.description: John Keim reports on Austin Ekeler preparing himself for his return after his Achilles injury that nearly ended his career.

items.headline: Are we seeing more NFL quarterback injuries than normal this season?
items.description: There have been eight QB injuries through three weeks of the NFL season, up a little bit from recent years. Is it a trend or just an outlier -- and is there a clear reason?

items.headline: London game reminds Marcus Mariota of the connection between football and soccer
items.description: For Mariota, who grew up playing soccer, Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium is a chance to combine his love of both sports.

items.headline: How are the Commanders preparing for the game in London?
items.description: John Keim reports on how head coach Dan Quinn is preparing the Commanders to play against the Colts in London in Week 4.
